name: Breeze TTS 2
access: Hugging Face weights BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2 (about 3.47B parameters in the file listing) and the breezeblue-ai/breeze-tts repository (Apache-2.0 code, PyTorch)
BreezeBlue hosted platform and API (breezeblue.ai): Studio, voice library and a realtime WebSocket API, model id breeze-tts-2
Self-hosted single-concurrency streaming API in the repository

voice.input_audio: Text with inline vocal-event tags; optional `instruction` text; optional reference audio plus its exact transcript for voice clone and voice direction [hf-breeze2]
voice.output_audio: Self-hosted streaming API: mono 24 kHz signed 16-bit little-endian PCM; the command-line tool writes a wav file [hf-breeze2]
voice.voices: voice design from a description with no reference audio; custom cloning from a clip with its transcript; direction of a cloned voice [hf-breeze2]
languages: Open weights: English and Chinese [hf-breeze2]. The hosted platform advertises 51 languages with accent control [bb-blog2]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model; the hosted realtime API keeps one WebSocket open across turns, and the client starts, appends to, flushes and ends each turn [bb-blog2]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model: the client stops playback
voice.latency: BreezeBlue, self-hosted on one NVIDIA H100 with the warmed fast path: under 40 ms to first audio and real-time factor 0.32 [hf-breeze2]. BreezeBlue's own latency benchmark of the hosted API: first audio at the median 133.6 ms and at the 95th percentile 163.3 ms, against 154.5 and 207.6 ms for ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 [bb-blog2]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Hosted plans are priced in credits: Free (400 credits a day), Starter US$9, Creator US$19 and Pro US$99 a month; 250,000, 600,000 and 3.5 million characters a month on the three paid plans; top-up credits cost US$3 for 5,000 [bb-pricing]; the model card says commercial use of hosted output needs a paid subscription [hf-breeze2]. The open weights are for research and non-commercial use only, and self-hosted output counts as non-commercial [hf-breeze2]. Self-hosting needs an NVIDIA GPU: about 7.7 GiB for eager inference, about 14.4 GiB with the fast path, and BreezeBlue advises a 12 GB or 24 GB card [hf-breeze2]
